rdfs:label: accuracy
rdfs:comment: The accuracy of an ActivityStreams Place's coordinates, expressed as a percentage (0–100).
notes: 0 means the position is essentially a guess; 100 is exact. Useful when the Place comes from GPS, IP geolocation, or any source whose precision varies. Distinct from `as:radius` (the size of the area covered) — accuracy describes the *uncertainty* of the centre point. Upstream domain is `as:Place`; `urn:solid:Place` maps to schema:Place, so when producing AS2 data type the node `as:Place` (as the example does) and use the AS latitude/longitude IRIs (`urn:solid:latitude`/`longitude` map to schema.org).

history.note: rdfs:domain now as:Place (urn:solid:Place is schema:Place); example uses AS Place/latitude/longitude IRIs.
